hypothesis: When high-frequency immune agent activity, excessive reasoning calls, or runaway message bursts threaten device battery and memory, RegulatoryTCell intervenes to throttle effectors, force deterministic fallback, and restore physiological equilibrium.
control: Basal state with 0 active incidents, 75% battery, 1200MB available RAM, bus rate < 1.0 msg/sec.
perturbation: Simulated immune self-stress: 35 rapid inter-cell message dispatches, concurrent multi-effector recruitment requests, battery level forced to 10% (discharging).
independent_variables: Immune bus dispatch rate (35 msg/sec vs 1.2 msg/sec)
dependent_variables: Macrophage scavenger recruitment (triggered on memory distress)

observed.reason: Battery critical (10%) and discharging. Suppressing high-energy reasoning.
Host memory severely constrained (90 MB free). Suppressing effector expansion.
Regulatory cooldown active: minimum inter-escalation gap not met (30000ms).

observable_host_effect: Device remains healthier after regulation: zero additional background coroutine allocations, expensive LLM calls completely blocked, and Macrophage cache reclamation triggers automatically.
